mestre_parent_portfolio_intake_v1.json.scope: Six fixed outer-parameter K3 parents. Exact rational sections and14-point specialized seeds; lower bounds from exact finite quotients and torsion exclusion. Profile16 I1 +2 I2 +split I4 at infinity, checked overQQ and at common good primes. Counts include regular-resolution corrections and independently check every smooth fibre by Sage. Different good-reduction point counts prove distinct Q-isomorphism classes of smooth projective K3 surfaces, hence distinct Q-birational parents; no geometric-isomorphism or literature-novelty claim. No rank13 inference from the earlier mixed-specialization certificate, no score or elliptic point enumeration.
